name: KiCad JLCPCB Interface
description: Browse JLCPCB/LCSC-linked schematic components and select them in Eeschema.

actions.name: JLCPCB Component Properties
actions.description: Open catalogue details for the one selected symbol carrying an LCSC custom property.

actions.name: JLCPCB Component Overview
actions.description: Browse all linked schematic components and estimate total cost and stock coverage.

actions.name: JLCPCB Populate Selected Symbol
actions.description: Preview and populate fields on one selected compatible resistor or capacitor symbol from an LCSC part number.

actions.name: JLCPCB Add Component from LCSC
actions.description: Search by LCSC code or resistor/capacitor value, review exact Basic/Extended catalogue matches, generate a reusable project-local KiCad symbol and place it at the cursor or by X/Y coordinates.
